findings.description: The policy grants the deployment IAM user full administrative action access (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:*) against every resource. This violates least privilege and permits broad data access and modification, including access to S3 data and potentially privilege escalation through Lambda or EC2 capabilities.

The output exposes the IAM access key encrypted secret value without marking it sensitive. Terraform will display and persist this credential material in outputs/state accessible to users or systems with state access, increasing the risk of credential disclosure.
